description: Tests first: connector required, scoped display/edit, forged target rejection, routing rollback and disabled management. comments.text: Simplification: remove PersonChannelRouting module; incoming-message management discovery and scoped form commands belong to existing IncomingMessageRouting, reuse AgentRouting conversion and persistence. PeopleGateway preserves transaction for channel + rules. Existing regression tests retained/moved to owner, not a parallel routing engine.

PersonChannelRouting module deleted; its regression file moved to IncomingMessageRoutingPeopleTest and all surviving tests invoke existing IncomingMessageRouting owner. Shared scope/choice validation converts channel form into ordinary incoming-message rules; gateway transaction still rolls back channel changes on forged/invalid targets. Obsolete references removed. 757-test focused validation green.
